title: Theravance Biopharma to Report Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results on November 10, 2025
summary: Pipeline Programs. Theravance Biopharma is a biopharmaceutical company with one approved product that was discovered and developed internally, a pipeline of internally discovered product candidates and strategic collaborations with pharmaceutical companies.
body_markdown:
DUBLIN


, Oct. 27, 2025


/PRNewswire/ -- Theravance Biopharma, Inc. (NASDAQ: TBPH) will report its third quarter 2025 financial results and provide a business update after market close on Monday, November 10, 2025. An accompanying conference call and simultaneous webcast will be hosted at 5:00 pm EST (2:00 pm PST / 10:00 pm GMT) that day.


**Conference Call Information**


To participate in the live call by telephone, please pre-register[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4541550-1&h=3347032149&u=https%3A%2F%2Fregister-conf.media-server.com%2Fregister%2FBId7f34fea811649b9a3a47e3ba29d2d2a&a=here) . Those interested in the live audio webcast of the conference call may access it by[clicking here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4541550-1&h=2504006091&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Frqsptkbx&a=clicking+here) or visiting the[Events and Presentation](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4541550-1&h=1596218951&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.theravance.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&a=Events+and+Presentation) page under the Investors Section on[Theravance Biopharma's website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4541550-1&h=547360270&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.theravance.com%2F&a=Theravance+Biopharma%27s+website) .


A replay of the webcast will be available on Theravance Biopharma's website for 30 days through December 10, 2025.


**About Theravance Biopharma**


Theravance Biopharma, Inc.'s focus is to deliver *Medicines that Make a Difference* ® in people's lives. In pursuit of its purpose, Theravance Biopharma leverages decades of expertise, which has led to the development of FDA-approved YUPELRI® (revefenacin) inhalation solution indicated for the maintenance treatment of patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Ampreloxetine, its late-stage investigational once-daily norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor in development for symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (nOH) in patients with Multiple System Atrophy (MSA), has the potential to be a first in class therapy effective in treating a constellation of cardinal symptoms in MSA patients. The Company is committed to creating/driving shareholder value.


For more information, please visit[www.theravance.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4541550-1&h=234650679&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.theravance.com%2F&a=www.theravance.com) .
